scope.cohort_policy: Reused L/DSL and new DL/SL are different time cohorts; new DSL is a contemporaneous control.
scope.compatibility: STEP-LM compatible maxi=20, no max_features; reported separately
scope.interaction_warning: Raw interaction is confounded with time cohort and is not a causal interaction estimate.
scope.main_effect_assumption: Balanced D/S log main effects use old L/DSL and new DL/SL; a common multiplicative cohort shift cancels.
scope.statistics: Three cold-JVM repetitions on a shared host; no significance claim.
